description: Keyword search across the organization's contacts, sessions, submissions, events, sponsors, forms, and portals; pass eventId to keep one event. Use it for exact names, emails, or titles; use semantic_search when the wording may differ. Not metered. Returns up to 20 permission-filtered results[] with type, id, title, and subtitle, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: search

eventName.description: Owning event's name, when the record belongs to an event.

eventNumber.description: Owning event's number, when the record belongs to an event.

matchKind.description: How the row was found: vector or text.

score.description: Ranking score. Only vector matches carry a real similarity; text matches carry a flat constant.

subtitle.description: Secondary line, e.g. company or status.

type.description: Record type: contact, session, submission, event, group, sponsor, form, or portal.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
